title: Continuous V-Channel Carving Gouge
description: One original static V-channel carving-gouge game prop. Two planar sloped inner wings meet at a sharp longitudinal valley; the complete steel-style shell includes a finite blunt V front lip, outer bevel, raised closed rear root, narrow neck and tang. A new twelve-facet wood-style handle has a real blind insertion cavity with a closed end and full tang seat. A complete thick through-bored ferrule meets a finite rear handle shoulder. Three separately editable closed connected meshes, three constant opaque PBR materials, no textures. Metres; native Z up, front -Y; two finite ground soles and centred horizontal envelope. Exactly one prop, zero scenes. Generic closed-mesh and export utilities are shared; all visible V-section, transition, grip and collar numerical profiles are newly authored. No cutting, sharpness, processing, load, ergonomic, manufacturing, real-world fit or safety claim. No workpiece, chips, blade set, animation or functional mechanism. Original chisel-form set remains partial.
